title: Maintaining sister-state relationships.
bodyText: The commission shall periodically evaluate established sister-state or province partnerships and forward its recommendations on maintaining sister-state or province partnerships to the governor and to the legislature.
bodyHtml: §229-4  Maintaining sister-state relationships.  The commission shall periodically evaluate established sister-state or province partnerships and forward its recommendations on maintaining sister-state or province partnerships to the governor and to the legislature. [L 2006, c 150, pt of §2; am L 2025, c 158, §9]
